notes: Fixed inputs named by a label are SHA-256(UTF-8("agora-test-vectors/" || label)), truncated to the stated length.

CBOR maps are encoded with RFC 8949 section 4.2.1 core deterministic key order and preferred integer widths. The spec does not require this order; it is one valid encoding, and receivers use the bytes as received.

signed = CBOR sfu-admission {ctx, sfu, nonce, channelToken}; admissionSig = Ed25519(admission seed, signed). The admission key and channelToken are the keyEpoch 0 values of channel-token.json. The challenge nonce is fixed here; the SFU sends a fresh random one.
